text:
kyle: quick sync — ACME on-prem handoff. Need owners for networking, images, and final certs. Any blockers?
anne: I can own networking until handoff. current blocker: customer asked for /22 instead of /24, need to confirm with infra team.
sanjay: noted. I already updated the peering doc but waiting on their firewall rules screenshot. pinged acct team to get it.
kyle: thx. can you also confirm if they'll accept NAT egress or need static egress IPs? that affects the shared LB plan.
sanjay: they explicitly asked for static egress IPs. we'll need to reserve and inject via onprem-egress config.
qiao: working on image transfer plan for air-gapped site. two options: rsync over secure jumpbox or ship an encrypted tarball + on-site install script. preference for rsync (simpler rollback).
carla: FYI security asked that any shipped images be signed and we provide checksum + signature. qiao, can you add signing step to the doc?
qiao: yes — will add. also adding these steps:
```
# on-host image install (example)
scp redwood-images.tar.gz jumpbox:/tmp
ssh jumpbox 'gpg --verify redwood-images.tar.gz.sig redwood-images.tar.gz'
ssh jumpbox 'tar xzf /tmp/redwood-images.tar.gz -C /opt/redwood'
```
kyle: nice. for network CIDR, anne — please paste the CIDR we provisioned and the sg rules we need. also, any IP whitelists from ACME?
anne: provisioning: 10.42.0.0/22. Required inbound: 10.42.0.0/22 for internal services, and customer will whitelist 203.0.113.45 for admin access. outbound: allow 443 to our upgrade buckets + 123/UDP for NTP.
carla: security: ensure ephemeral credentials rotated during handoff. we require KMS-wrapped service account keys, not plaintext.
sanjay: noted. dependency list for rollout:
- acct: final firewall screenshots (owner: acct)
- infra: reserved static egress IPs (owner: sanjay)
- devex: on-site install script + signed images (owner: qiao)
- security: KMS key provisioning + rotation policy (owner: carla)
- support: runbook + SLOs (owner: kyle)
kyle: owners noted. timeline: block 1 — network + certs by EOD Wed (1765925600). block 2 — image transfer + test install by Fri. can everyone confirm?
anne: confirm for networking, will escalate if customer doesn't confirm CIDR by tomorrow.
sanjay: confirm infra will reserve egress IPs by Thu morning.
qiao: confirm images + signing by Thu EOD; will run a dry install in staging Thu night.
carla: security will provision KMS and share key ARN to the handoff doc by Wed afternoon.
deploy-bot: deploy:preflight job queued for ACME-onprem at 1765842000 — will run health checks once images are uploaded. :robot_face:
kyle: awesome. quick code review ping for the onprem config PR #492 — @anne @sanjay can you take a look? it's mostly CIDR and bootstrap env changes.
anne: will review in the morning.
sanjay: on my list, aiming for today.
kyle: last: any air-gap-specific runbook additions? think about how to handle emergency patching (manual pull vs scheduled shipped bundles).
qiao: adding emergency patching section to runbook with steps for signed patch bundles and manual install and rollback.
carla: add contact matrix for local ops + our oncall in case of post-install issues.
kyle: perfect. I'll consolidate owners into the handoff doc and send to ACME once we have firewall screenshots. thanks all. :thumbsup:
